task.title: Lean source structure and remove wrapper seams
task.summary: Remove wrapper-only application seams and stale compatibility re-exports while aligning docs/tests to the lean domain/application/adapters structure.

goal.outcome: Code and docs use the lean actual structure with no empty application compiler/gateway/profile wrappers or stale internal compatibility re-exports.
acceptance: Wrapper-only `src/application/compilers/**` files are removed unless they own real behavior.
Wrapper-only `src/application/gateway/profiles/**` files are removed unless they own real behavior.
Internal imports of task-boundary helpers use the domain owner directly and `src/application/task-boundary.ts` is removed.
The stale `src/adapters/web/control-room.ts` compatibility re-export is removed after repo imports/tests point to `src/ui/web/control-room.ts`.
System docs do not require placeholder `application/gateways/**`, `application/compilers/**`, or `application/state-engine/**` paths.
Dependency/reference scan shows no live imports of removed wrapper paths.
Typecheck, architecture audit, smoke/features/pack tests, stale-reference audit, and CodeWiki state refresh pass or document only generated-state warnings.
non_goals: Do not purge tracked `.codewiki` history/builds/validation archives before this cleanup is committed and GC has commit/tree proof.
Do not remove public `codewiki_claim` compatibility alias in this cleanup.
Do not refactor domain/shared type ownership beyond import cleanup needed for removed wrappers.
verification: python dependency/reference scan for removed wrapper paths

delta.desired: Lean source structure without placeholder wrapper seams; docs and tests match actual domain/application/adapters ownership.
delta.current: Docs have been aligned and source deletion/import migration is in progress.
delta.closure: Task closes after source wrappers are removed, docs/tests align, and checks pass.
